notes.title: New Quality & Changes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We’ve got something big to share. 

After careful consideration, plenty of testing, and a whole lot of team discussions, we’ve made a major decision for the future of [b]Sniper at Work[/b]:
[b]We’re switching from Unity to Unreal Engine.[/b]

Why? 
Because we want this game to be as [b]immersive[/b], [b]polished[/b], and [b]dynamic [/b]as possible. And Unreal gives us the tools to get there better visual fidelity, more robust AI systems, and the kind of physics-driven chaos that we know this game is capable of delivering.

This isn’t just a technical upgrade it’s a creative one. Unreal gives us more power to [b]bring our vision to life[/b], from the tension of that perfect sniper shot to the wild, unpredictable mess when things go sideways. Simply put, it’s going to make [b]Sniper at Work look better, feel better, and play better[/b].

We’re still early in development, and this change will take a bit of time but we believe it’s absolutely worth it. You’ll start seeing the results soon, with [b]new visuals, gameplay clips, and behind-the-scenes peeks[/b] at how the game is evolving.

Thanks for sticking with us—we’re building something special, and this move is a big step toward that goal.


More soon!

[i]The Sniper at Work Team[/i]

notes.title: Introducing - Sniper at Work
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Two weeks ago, we took a deep breath and hit publish on our Sniper at Work Steam page. Since then, we’ve been absolutely blown away by the support—you’ve wishlisted, checked out the page, and even left some kind words. For a small team like ours, that means everything.

We’re just a handful of people with a love for games and a crazy idea that’s been living rent-free in our heads for years. Sniper at Work is that idea finally coming to life—our take on precision sniping mixed with unpredictable chaos. It’s a game where you plan every shot carefully… until things inevitably go sideways.

What Is Sniper at Work?
At its core, Sniper at Work is about precision, planning, and the beautiful disasters that follow. You’re a sniper-for-hire, taking on jobs that demand stealth, patience, and sometimes… creativity.

🎯 Nail the perfect shot—or adapt when things go wrong
🛠️ Set traps, manipulate the environment, and improvise
💥 Missions react to your choices—whether brilliant or disastrous
😏 And, yes, there’s a bit of dark humor in the mix

The game is inspired by some of the greatest top-down action games and classic gangster movies of the ‘90s. We’ve also drawn a lot of inspiration from certain infamous sniper missions in open-world crime games—those moments where you line up a shot, take it, and suddenly the whole city is after you.

Exciting Things Ahead!
This is just the beginning. Stick with us—we’ve got some really exciting announcements coming in the next few weeks and months. We can’t wait to show you more!

Oh yeah, don’t forget to wishlist!

Martin, Mike, Nikita, Pawel, Jakub, Aneta, Lukasz, Kacper
